proposed: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
changes.evidence: Jon Jon is employed by Xialing as the ringmaster of her fight club; on screen he greets Shang-Chi and Katy with 'Welcome to the Golden Daggers Club!' and runs the fights (an employer counts as a group). In the post-credits scene, after Wenwu's death, Xialing takes over the Ten Rings and takes the throne with Razor Fist and Jon Jon at her side (MCU Wiki lists him as a Ten Rings member). 'Golden Daggers Club' and 'The Ten Rings' are the dataset's existing names.

Remove the Iron Fist S2 left. Joy's last stage is already Independent at Iron Fist S1: she leaves New York for Paris to join Davos in episode 13, and Ward says Joy has left the company. In Iron Fist S2 she belongs to no group. She only finalizes her buyout in episode 1 and then breaks off her partnership with Davos, who is an ally, not a group. The S2 left is left over from the old stage list, which put her Independent stage at S2.

In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1, episode 10 ('The Bridge'), Mike Peterson trains as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and joins Coulson's team on the Bus: 'training to be an agent, working with S.H.I.E.L.D.'. Only after that does Centipede take him and turn him into Deathlok, the Clairvoyant's (HYDRA's) asset from episode 13 on. The villain file misses the S1 S.H.I.E.L.D. stage and has HYDRA before Project Centipede. Its twin A:st-mike-peterson already has the right order: Project Centipede, S.H.I.E.L.D., HYDRA, Independent (all S1), then S.H.I.E.L.D. (S2).

owner_calls.question: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2 (episodes 18 and 19), Deathlok poses as Sunil Bakshi's bodyguard and works inside HYDRA for List, undercover for Coulson, until Bakshi betrays him and HYDRA captures him. Under the rule that undercover service counts, should S2 get a HYDRA stage between the S.H.I.E.L.D. stages?
options: Keep [S.H.I.E.L.D., Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2] as the last stage (a one-mission cover, not service)
owner_calls.evidence: 'Peterson was able to pose as Bakshi's bodyguard to attend a meeting between Bakshi and List... walking through the hallways... as though he was working for Hydra... in order to still maintain his undercover mission with them' (AoS 218-219). The cover lasts for a single operation.

owner_calls.question: In Captain America: The First Avenger, Kruger infiltrates the U.S. Department of State as 'Fred Clemson' and attends Project Rebirth as a government observer. Undercover service counts, but I can't confirm the screen names his cover employer. Add a stage for it?
options: Use [HYDRA, CA:TFA], [United States Department of State, CA:TFA], [HYDRA, CA:TFA]
owner_calls.evidence: MCU Wiki: 'living as Fred Clemson and infiltrating the United States Department of State as a Hydra spy... Kruger, as Fred Clemson of the United States Department of State... sat with the many government officials and generals'. He blows his cover at the test, kills Erskine, and dies saying 'Hail Hydra'.
